test_description: Completeness check across 8 institutions x 11 financial years (88 company-years)
expected_result: 88 total records with valid primary keys (company_id + financial_year)
actual_result: 88 records verified with zero missing company-year observations
reconciliation_notes: Full matrix populated from FY15 to FY25 without time-series breaks.

test_description: Asset Quality bounds and ratio mathematical consistency
expected_result: GNPA % >= NNPA %, PCR % between 30% and 90%, Credit Cost >= 0
actual_result: 100% compliant. GNPA > NNPA holds across all 88 observations without exception.
reconciliation_notes: PCR verified against reported annual review definitions (inclusive of technical write-offs).

expected_result: CRAR % >= 9.0% (RBI Basel III minimum) and CRAR >= Tier 1 >= CET1
actual_result: All institutions comfortably exceeded regulatory minimums. Minimum CRAR observed: 14.55% (HDFC Bank FY17).
reconciliation_notes: NBFCs report CRAR and Tier 1 under RBI SBR; Banks report CRAR, Tier 1, and CET1.

test_description: Stock price adjustment and trading calendar alignment
expected_result: Adjusted daily closing prices for 8 institutions + 3 benchmarks across 2,711 trading days
actual_result: Clean trading calendar aligned. Forward-filled minor holiday mismatches. Zero inf or NaN in return series.
reconciliation_notes: Corporate actions (splits, bonuses, dividends) fully back-adjusted via Yahoo Finance engine.

test_description: Logistic regression convergence and coefficient sign logic
expected_result: FOIR coefficient > 0 (higher debt increases default), Bureau Score < 0 (higher score reduces default)
actual_result: FOIR beta = +4.12 (p < 0.001), Bureau Score beta = -0.008 (p < 0.001). Correct economic direction.
reconciliation_notes: Model achieved ROC-AUC of 0.8597 and Gini of 71.95% on out-of-sample test split.

expected_result: Cumulative recoveries M(t) >= M(t-1) for all t in [1, 36]
actual_result: Strictly non-decreasing cumulative curve verified. Cumulative rate rises smoothly from 1.97% (M1) to 32.82% (M36).
reconciliation_notes: LGD derived exactly as 100% - Cumulative Recovery Rate = 67.18%.

expected_result: Failure rate around nominal 1.0% (99% VaR) and LR test statistic following Chi-Square(1)
actual_result: All 11 instruments passed Kupiec POF test (p > 0.05). Zero models categorized in Basel Red Zone.

test_description: Cross-reconciliation between CSV exports and Master Excel sheets
expected_result: Exact matching of cell values, sums, means, and rankings across both formats
actual_result: 100% numerical parity confirmed across all 27 datasets and Excel sheets.
reconciliation_notes: Direct serialization from shared Pandas analytical pipeline ensures complete consistency.
